title: Textured vest with ribbed sides
excerpt: A drop-shoulder vest in aran yarn with a ribbed vertical panel down the centre front and back, flanked by plain dc panels at the sides. The contrast of rib and dc gives the vest a structured, tidy look. Graded XS to 3XL.
sourceNotes: Vests combining rib centre panels with plain dc sides are a practical post-stitch garment project.

glossaryTerms.definition: A vertical band of 1x1 fpdc/bpdc rib running down the centre third of the front and back. The rib draws in slightly at the centre and provides a visual anchor for the vest silhouette.
Plain double crochet panels on each side of the centre rib. The dc fabric drapes more softly and sits flatter than the rib, creating a contrast in texture and a slight shaping effect at the sides.

crochet.gaugeText: 14 dc x 16 rows = 10 x 10 cm in aran on a 5 mm hook.
crochet.finishedSizeText: Graded XS to 3XL. Size M: 104.3 cm bust.

content.text: Divide each piece into three vertical zones: a plain dc side panel, a
. The rib panel covers the centre third of the stitch count on both front and back. Work all three zones simultaneously on each row. Seam shoulders. Work a 2-round dc armhole border each side.
Size M: 146 sts wide, 81.7 cm body. Centre rib: approx 49 sts.
Chain 148. Establish three zones: dc, rib (centre 49 sts), dc. Work for 81.7 cm. Shape neck. Seam shoulders.
Seam sides. Work 2-round dc armhole border. Work 2-round dc neckline border.
The wide-rib cardigan works a 2x2 rib across the full width of the garment for a single all-over texture.

steps: Work back panel: cast on 60 stitches, work straight for 123 rows.
Work front panel the same as back, shaping a shallow neckline over the final 17 rows.
Work each sleeve: cast on 50, increase evenly to 98 over 100 rows.
Sew shoulder seams leaving a 41cm gap for the neckline.
Lay each sleeve flat across the open armhole and sew in place along the straight edge.
Sew side seams and underarm seams in one continuous line.
Pick up 58 stitches around the neckline and work neck trim. Weave in ends and block.
